description: WaterWatch is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGS, United States Geological Survey. Explore maps, graphs, and tables describing real-time, recent, and past streamflow conditions for the United States. The real-time information generally is updated on an hourly basis. The Waterwatch site Maps show streamflow conditions for real-time, average daily, and seven-day average streamflow. The real-time streamflow maps highlight flood and high flow conditions. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – General, Water Quality. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Water Infrastructure – General, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
